definitions.full: H8387. Taanath Shiloh שִׁלֹ֑ה תַּאֲנַת proper name, of a location on border of Ephraim Josh 16:6 ; Θηνασα Καὶ Σελλησα , A Τηναθσηλω , ᵐ5 L Θηναθασηλω ; according to Survey WP ii. 232, 245 Wilson Hast. DB TAANATH-SHILOH Buhl Geogr. 202 = modern Ta`na , approximately 7 miles east-southeast from Nablûs.
